newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesia late rubber stable, on rupiah watch.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia late rubber stable, on rupiah watch.

text.p: Indonesian tyre-grade SIR20 rubber prices were mostly stable in late trading on Tuesday, with players keeping a close watch on the rupiah, traders said.
"The constantly changing exchange rate between the rupiah and U.S. dollar is making it difficult for sellers to conclude deals," one trader said.
"My margin could be affected if I agree to ship rubber at today's rate and the dollar weakens after that," he said, adding that he was staying out of the market for the moment.

Traders said tyre-maker Michelin and Singapore dealers bought October shipment SIR20 at 41.50 U.S. cents/lb fob Palembang late on Monday. They said October shipment was done at 41.625 cents/lb fob Padang and Jambi.

"Michelin and Singapore dealers bought some rubber from Palembang," one trader said. "Buyers, in general, are putting pressure on prices because of the decline of the rupiah against the dollar." Local prices are quoted in the U.S. currency.
Traders said October SIR20 was on offer at 42.00 cents/lb fob Medan, 41.50-41.75 cents fob Palembang, 41.625 cents fob Padang and 41.125 cents fob Surabaya.
